photo_usable.instructions: The photo is sharp and well lit, and shows the device clearly enough to judge its physical condition.

shows_declared_category.instructions: The photo shows a device of the declared category.

visible_damage.instructions: The device has visible physical damage (crack, dent, break, burn, liquid marks); ignore packaging and shadows.

use_dirt.instructions: Visible dirt, fingerprints or stains on the device.

use_wear.instructions: Visible wear (worn keys, rubbed paint, polished areas).

missing_protective_film.instructions: A factory protective film is visibly missing where one is normally present (only if this can be judged).

missing_accessories.instructions: Accessories that normally belong in the photographed set are visibly missing (only if this can be judged).

state: Zgłoszona kategoria sprzętu: Smartfon. Rodzaj zgłoszenia: Zwrot.
